links.to_node: not implement the new power grid system.
The city will not experience a temporary shutdown or city-wide blackout.
Energy consumption in the city will remain at current levels.
Residents will continue to pay existing energy taxes without reduction.
The city will not benefit from a more stable and sustainable power supply in the near future.
Potential long-term improvements in the power grid will be delayed or not realized.
